_doc: Ohm's Brownout Pistol (Project Redmond R3, gadgets/R3_OPERATORS.md §2; Ulo's design): his ability, the item in his slot 2 (Z). A heavy pistol that fires one EMP round a magazine: `count` magazines a round, each reloaded in `use.reloadS`. A round flies straight from the eye (judged as a bullet, rewound), stops at the first wall, floor, prop, body or shield within `use.rangeM`, and bursts just short of it: the defenders' electronic devices and bodies within `emp.radiusM` (a sphere, through walls and floors) are off and jammed for `emp.seconds`. Aiming (ADS) looks through its scope: the view tinted blue and a blue dot on every device of theirs a round could turn off (gadgets/electronics.ts empTargets; dots, never outlines). Its numbers are ours.
name: Brownout Pistol
